买.pinyin: Yé ye mǎi gěi wǒ de
Wǒ xiǎng mǎi xiē xuē zi
买.en: I would like to purchase some boots.

买.zh: 她告诉我她妈妈买给她了。
买.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ tā mā ma mǎi gěi tā le
买.en: She told me her mum bought it for her.
买.es: Ella me dijo que su madre se lo había comprado.

买.pinyin: Tā men mǎi le yī hé qū qí
买.en: They bought a box of cookies.
买.es: Ellos compraron una caja de galletas.

认识.zh: 你记不记得我们认识的那一天？
认识.pinyin: Nǐ jì bù jì de wǒ men rèn shi de nà yī tiān
认识.en: Do you remember the day when we first met?
认识.es: ¿Te acuerdas del día en que nos conocimos?

认识.pinyin: Wǒ rèn shi tā liǎng nián le
认识.en: I have known her for two years.
认识.es: Hace dos años que le conozco.

认识.zh: 让我介绍我父母给你认识。
认识.pinyin: Ràng wǒ jiè shào wǒ fù mǔ gěi nǐ rèn shi
认识.en: Let me introduce my parents to you.

认识.pinyin: A wǒ rèn shi zhè ge nán rén

到.pinyin: Nǐ néng cāi dào wǒ de nián líng ma
到.en: Can you guess how old I am?

到.pinyin: Nǐ néng cāi dào wǒ yǒu shén me ma
到.en: Can you guess what I have here?

到.pinyin: Wǒ wǔ diǎn dào nǐ jiā lái jiē nǐ
到.en: I'll pick you up at your home at five.
到.es: Te recogeré en tu casa a las cinco.

到.pinyin: Tā yī dào wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ
到.en: As soon as she comes, we will begin.

走.zh: 你走了，我们都会想你的。
走.pinyin: Nǐ zǒu le wǒ men dū huì xiǎng nǐ de
走.en: We shall all miss you when you go away.
走.es: Te echaremos de menos cuando te vayas.

走.pinyin: Hǎo le wǒ bì xū zǒu le
Nǐ xiǎng zǒu de shí hou jiù zǒu ba

新.zh: 一个是新的，另一个是旧的。
新.pinyin: Yī ge shì xīn de lìng yī gè shì jiù de
新.en: One is new, and the other is old.
新.es: Uno es nuevo y el otro es viejo.

新.zh: 我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。
新.pinyin: Wǒ hái le cóng tú shū guǎn jiè de shū yòu jiè le xiē xīn de
新.en: I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
新.es: Devolví los libros que había sacado de la biblioteca y me llevé prestados otros nuevos.

新.pinyin: Wǒ xīn jiā de kè tīng hěn kuān chang
新.en: The living room in my new house is very large.
新.es: La sala de mi casa nueva es muy amplia.

新.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào yǒu tái xīn diàn nǎo

姐姐.zh: 他老是把我和我姐姐搞错。
姐姐.pinyin: Tā lǎo shi bǎ wǒ hé wǒ jiě jie gǎo cuò
姐姐.en: He always mistakes me for my sister.
姐姐.es: Él siempre me confunde con mi hermana mayor.

姐姐.pinyin: Tā yǒu sān gè jiě jie
Wǒ jiě jie duì wǎng qiú zháo mí
姐姐.en: My sister is crazy about tennis.
姐姐.es: Mi hermana mayor está entusiasmada con el tenis.
Sigue el ejemplo de tu hermana.

地.zh: 他简单地阐述了他的理由。
地.pinyin: Tā jiǎn dān de chǎn shù le tā de lǐ yóu
地.en: He gave his reasons in brief.
地.es: Él dio sus razones de forma resumida.

地.zh: 我们毫不费力地想出了密码。
地.pinyin: Wǒ men háo bù fèi lì de xiǎng chū le mì mǎ
地.en: We easily figured out the password.

地.zh: 他毫不犹豫地把自己的车卖了。
地.pinyin: Tā háo bù yóu yù de bǎ zì jǐ de chē mài le
地.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
地.es: Vendió su propio coche sin vacilar lo más mínimo.

地.zh: 你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。
地.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ háo wú wèn tí de biàn bié hái zi men de shēng yīn
地.en: You can identify children's voices without any problem.
地.es: Logras identificar las voces de niños sin ningún problema.

感兴趣.zh: 我对亚洲的历史很感兴趣。
感兴趣.pinyin: Wǒ duì yà zhōu de lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
感兴趣.en: I am interested in Asian history.
感兴趣.es: Me interesa la historia de Asia.

感兴趣.zh: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
感兴趣.pinyin: Nǐ jué de tā huì duì shén me zhǔ tí gǎn xìng qù
感兴趣.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
感兴趣.es: ¿En qué tema crees que está interesado?

感兴趣.pinyin: Nǐ duì yīn yuè gǎn bù gǎn xìng qù
Nǐ duì zhèng zhì gǎn xìng qù ma

除了.zh: 那儿除了我，一个人都没有。
除了.pinyin: Nàr chú le wǒ yī gè rén dōu méi yǒu
除了.en: There was no one there besides me.
除了.es: Allí no había nadie aparte de mí.

除了.zh: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
除了.pinyin: Chú le yǔ tiān wǒ dōu shì qí chē qù shàng bān de
除了.en: I go to the office by bicycle except on rainy days.
除了.es: Voy en bicicleta a la oficina salvo los días de lluvia.

除了.zh: 除了雾我什么都看不见。
除了.pinyin: Chú le wù wǒ shén me dōu kàn bu jiàn
除了.en: I could see nothing but fog.

除了.zh: 除了胡萝卜，他没有什么是不吃的。
除了.pinyin: Chú le hú luó bo tā méi yǒu shén me shì bù chī de
除了.en: Except for carrots, there is nothing he won't eat.
除了.es: Salvo las zanahorias, no hay nada que no coma.

永远.zh: 总有一些东西我永远不能学会，我的生命不是永恒的！
永远.pinyin: Zǒng yǒu yī xiē dōng xi wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù néng xué huì wǒ de shēng mìng bù shì yǒng héng de
永远.en: There will always be things I will never learn, I don't have eternity before me!
永远.es: Siempre habrá cosas que nunca aprenderé, ¡no tengo toda la eternidad ante mí!

永远.pinyin: Wǒ men huì yǒng yuǎn zài yī qǐ

永远.zh: 我永远不会忘记你的亲切。
永远.pinyin: Wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nǐ de qīn qiè
永远.en: I shall never forget your kindness.
永远.es: Jamás me olvidaré de tu amabilidad.

永远.pinyin: Zhè ge yǒng yuǎn wán bù liǎo le
永远.en: This is never going to end.

台.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī tái diàn nǎo
Wǒ men jiā zhōng yǒu liǎng tái diàn shì
台.en: In our house there are two televisions.
台.es: En nuestra casa hay dos televisiones.

台.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào yǒu tái xīn diàn nǎo

台.zh: 你能用这台相机帮我们拍张照吗？
台.pinyin: Nǐ néng yòng zhè tái xiàng jī bāng wǒ men pāi zhāng zhào ma
台.en: Would you take a picture of us with this camera?
台.es: ¿Nos puedes hacer una foto con esta cámara?

地址.pinyin: Duì le nǐ de dì zhǐ shì shén me
地址.en: By the way, what is your address?

地址.zh: 她问我知不知道他的地址。
地址.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ zhī bù zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ
地址.en: She asked me if I knew his address.
地址.es: Ella me preguntó si conocía su dirección.

地址.zh: 能说给我听你的地址吗？
地址.pinyin: Néng shuō gěi wǒ tīng nǐ de dì zhǐ ma
地址.en: Can you tell me your address?

地址.zh: 对了，可以把你的地址告诉我吗？
地址.pinyin: Duì le kě yǐ bǎ nǐ de dì zhǐ gào su wǒ ma
地址.en: By the way, what is your address?

杂志.pinyin: Tā shì shí dài zá zhì de jì zhě
杂志.en: He is a reporter for Time magazine.
杂志.es: Es un reportero de la revista Time.

杂志.zh: 我能看一眼那本杂志吗？
杂志.pinyin: Wǒ néng kàn yī yǎn nà běn zá zhì ma
杂志.en: Can I have a look at the magazine?

杂志.zh: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。
杂志.pinyin: Zhè běn zá zhì bù yào rēng wǒ hái méi kàn ne
杂志.en: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
杂志.es: No tires esa revista. Todavía no la he leído.

杂志.zh: 这种杂志对年轻人有害。
杂志.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zá zhì duì nián qīng rén yǒu hài
杂志.en: This kind of magazine can do harm to young people.
杂志.es: Este tipo de revistas puede causarle un daño a la gente joven.

观众.zh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。
观众.pinyin: Tā de yǎn shuō yíng dé le guān zhòng rè liè de zhǎng shēng
观众.en: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.
观众.es: La audiencia aplaudió ruidosamente tras su discurso.

观众.zh: 所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。
观众.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu de guān zhòng dōu zhàn qǐ lai gǔ zhǎng
观众.en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
观众.es: Toda la audiencia se puso de pie y comenzó a aplaudir.

观众.zh: 尽管如此，观众中仍有些人不满意这个结果。
观众.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn rú cǐ guān zhòng zhōng réng yǒu xiē rén bù mǎn yì zhè ge jié guǒ
观众.en: However, some people in the audience were not pleased with the results.
观众.es: Sin embargo, algunas personas entre el público no estaban satisfechas con los resultados.

观众.pinyin: Guān zhòng sì hū jué de wú liáo
观众.en: The audience seems to feel bored.

困.pinyin: Wǒ bèi gōng zuò kùn zhù le
困.es: Estoy obligado a continuar en mi empleo.

困.pinyin: Kùn le de huà jiù shuō o
困.en: If you are tired just let me know.

竞争.zh: 但是，在「真实的大人世界」里是有很多竞争的。
竞争.pinyin: Dàn shì zài zhēn shí de dà ren shì jiè lǐ shì yǒu hěn duō jìng zhēng de
竞争.en: And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.
竞争.es: Sin embargo, en el "mundo de los adultos" hay mucha competencia.

竞争.zh: 这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。
竞争.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zú qiú sài chōng mǎn zhe jī qíng hé jīng cǎi de jìng zhēng
竞争.en: This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.
竞争.es: Este partido de fútbol está lleno de competencia enérgica y espléndida.

竞争.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā jìng zhēng guàn jūn
竞争.en: I competed with him for the championship.

竞争.pinyin: Tā bèi jìng zhēng gōng sī wā qù le
竞争.en: He was hired away by a rival company.

博士.zh: 我正在在波士顿读博士。
博士.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zài zài bō shì dùn dú bó shì
博士.en: I'm in Boston going for my Ph.D. right now.
博士.es: Ahora mismo, estoy haciendo el doctorado en Boston.

博士.zh: 我可以把你介绍给强森博士吗?
博士.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ bǎ nǐ jiè shào gěi jiàng sēn bó shì ma
博士.en: May I introduce you to Dr. Johnson?

博士.zh: 汤川博士在科学研究上起了很重要的作用。
博士.pinyin: Tāng chuān bó shì zài kē xué yán jiū shàng qǐ le hěn zhòng yào de zuò yòng
博士.en: Dr. Yukawa played an important part in the scientific study.

博士.zh: 预定在一点半与博士见面。
博士.pinyin: Yù dìng zài yī diǎn bàn yǔ bó shì jiàn miàn
博士.en: I planned to meet the professor at 1:30.

人类.pinyin: Ái zhèng shì rén lèi de dà dí
人类.en: Cancer is a great enemy of humanity.
人类.es: El cáncer es un gran enemigo de la humanidad.

人类.zh: 音乐是人类共通的语言。
人类.pinyin: Yīn yuè shì rén lèi gòng tōng de yǔ yán
人类.en: Music is a common speech for humanity.
人类.es: La música es una lengua común para la humanidad.

人类.pinyin: Rén lèi shì huán jìng de chǎn wù
人类.en: Man is a creature of circumstances.

人类.zh: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。
人类.pinyin: Nà shi rén lèi dì yī cì zài yuè qiú shàng xíng zǒu
人类.en: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.

数.zh: 在你两岁时, 你可以数到十。
数.pinyin: Zài nǐ liǎng suì shí nǐ kě yǐ shǔ dào shí
数.en: You could count to ten when you were two.
数.es: Tú podías contar hasta diez cuando tenías dos años.

数.zh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
数.pinyin: Shuǐ ní huì zài shǔ gè xiǎo shí nèi níng gù
数.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
数.es: El cemento fraguará en un par de horas.

数.zh: 我数着星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。
数.pinyin: Wǒ shǔ zhe xīng xiù de xīng guāng lái yù cè wǒ ài qíng de wèi lái
数.en: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.

碰.pinyin: Bù yào pèng wǒ de chē
Bù yào pèng wǒ de xiàng jī
Bié pèng wǒ de xiàng jī

称.pinyin: Tā men chēng tā dǎn xiǎo guǐ

称.zh: 这个产品称它能帮助你减肥。
称.pinyin: Zhè ge chǎn pǐn chēng tā néng bāng zhù nǐ jiǎn féi
称.en: This product claims to help you lose weight.
称.es: Este producto afirma que ayuda a perder peso.

称.zh: 外交部长称战争在所难免。
称.pinyin: Wài jiāo bù zhǎng chēng zhàn zhēng zài suǒ nán miǎn
称.en: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
称.es: El Ministro de Asuntos Exteriores dijo que la guerra era inevitable.

称.zh: 山中无老虎, 猴子称大王。
称.pinyin: Shān zhōng wú lǎo hǔ hóu zi chēng dà wáng
称.en: When the landlord's away, the tenants will play.
称.es: Cuando el casero no está, los inquilinos juegan.

相似.pinyin: Nǐ de wèn tí hé wǒ de xiāng sì
相似.en: Your problem is similar to mine.
相似.es: Tu problema es parecido al mío.

相似.pinyin: Nǐ de yì jiàn gēn wǒ de xiāng sì
相似.en: Your opinion is similar to mine.
相似.es: Tu opinión es similar a la mía.

相似.pinyin: Nǐ wǒ de wèn tí hěn xiāng sì
相似.en: Your problem and mine are similar.
相似.es: Tu problema y el mío son parecidos.

相似.zh: 你的脚踏车和我的很相似。
相似.pinyin: Nǐ de jiǎo tà chē hé wǒ de hěn xiāng sì
相似.en: Your bicycle is similar to mine.
相似.es: Su bicicleta es similar a la mía.

财产.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de cái chǎn

财产.zh: 他在遗嘱里说要把他的财产全部留给他的妻子。
财产.pinyin: Tā zài yí zhǔ lǐ shuō yào bǎ tā de cái chǎn quán bù liú gěi tā de qī zi
财产.en: He left all his property to his wife in his will.
财产.es: Dejó todas sus propiedades a su mujer en su testamento.

财产.zh: 我把我的财产托付给他。
财产.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ wǒ de cái chǎn tuō fù gěi tā
财产.en: I entrusted my property to him.

财产.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。
财产.pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de cái chǎn chuán gěi le tā ér zi
财产.en: He passed his property on to his son.

逐渐.pinyin: Wǒ fù qīn zhú jiàn hǎo zhuǎn le
逐渐.en: My father is getting better by degrees.
逐渐.es: Mi padre se va recuperando de a poco.

逐渐.pinyin: Bìng rén zhú jiàn kāng fù le
逐渐.en: The patient got better little by little.
逐渐.es: El paciente se recuperó poco a poco.

逐渐.pinyin: Tiān kōng zhú jiàn míng liàng le qǐ lai
逐渐.es: Poco a poco el cielo está clareando.

逐渐.pinyin: Tā zhú jiàn kāi shǐ míng bai
逐渐.es: Ella empezó de poco a poco a entender.

围巾.zh: 我想给妻子买一件礼物。我打算买一条围巾。
围巾.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi qī zi mǎi yī jiàn lǐ wù wǒ dǎ suàn mǎi yī tiáo wéi jīn
围巾.en: I would like to buy a present for my wife. I thought about a scarf.
围巾.es: Quisiera comprar un regalo para mi esposa. Estaba pensando en un pañuelo.

围巾.zh: 女孩的脖子上围着一条长长的围巾。
围巾.pinyin: Nǚ hái de bó zi shàng wéi zhe yī tiáo cháng cháng de wéi jīn
围巾.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
围巾.es: La muchacha llevaba una larga bufanda alrededor de su cuello.

围巾.zh: 不论天气冷还热，她出门总带着围巾。
围巾.pinyin: Bù lùn tiān qì lěng hái rè tā chū mén zǒng dài zhe wéi jīn
围巾.en: No matter whether it is cold or hot, when she goes out, she always brings a scarf.
围巾.es: Haga frío o calor, ella nunca sale sin su bufanda.

围巾.zh: 你不喜欢我的黄围巾吗？
围巾.pinyin: Nǐ bù xǐ huan wǒ de huáng wéi jīn ma
围巾.en: Don't you like my yellow scarf?

轮流.pinyin: Wǒ men lún liú kāi chē
轮流.en: We took turns driving the car.

轮流.pinyin: Wǒ men lún liú jià shǐ
轮流.en: We took turns with the driving.

轮流.zh: 那间旧屋里只有一张床，所以我们便轮流睡觉。
轮流.pinyin: Nà jiān jiù wū lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng chuáng suǒ yǐ wǒ men biàn lún liú shuì jiào
轮流.en: The old cottage had only one bed, so we all took turns sleeping in it.
轮流.es: La vieja cabaña tenía sólo una cama, así que todos hacíamos turnos para dormir en ella.

轮流.pinyin: Wǒ hé tāng mǔ lún liú kāi chē
轮流.en: Tom and I took turns driving the car.

上当.pinyin: Wǒ bù huì shàng dàng de

上当.zh: 他是个忠厚老实的人，不免上当。
上当.pinyin: Tā shì gè zhōng hòu lǎo shi de rén bù miǎn shàng dàng
上当.en: He is an honest person, and he will always be lied to.

挂号.zh: 我想要用挂号寄这封信。
挂号.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào yòng guà hào jì zhè fēng xìn
挂号.en: I want to have this letter registered.

挂号.pinyin: Qǐng yòng guà hào jì zhè ge
挂号.en: Please send this by registered mail.

无奈.zh: “天天寒暄就是我们做的所有事了。”汤姆无奈地回答。
无奈.pinyin: Tiān tiān hán xuān jiù shì wǒ men zuò de suǒ yǒu shì le tāng mǔ wú nài de huí dá
无奈.en: "Exchanging courtesies every day is all we've done," Tom answered with resignation.

无奈.pinyin: Wǒ wú nài zhǐ dé gēn suí zhe tā
无奈.en: I was compelled to follow her.

无奈.pinyin: Tā duì shēng huó gǎn dào hěn wú nài
无奈.en: He feels powerless about his own life.

灰.pinyin: Jī qì méng shàng le yī céng huī
灰.en: The machine was coated with dust.
灰.es: La máquina fue cubierta con polvo.

灰.pinyin: Gé lóu shàng jī le huī
灰.en: Dust had accumulated in the attic.
灰.es: El polvo se había acumulado en el desván.

腰.pinyin: Wǒ yāo téng bù néng dǎ wǎng qiú
腰.en: My back hurts; I can't play tennis.

而已.pinyin: Zhè jǐn shì nǐ de xiǎng xiàng ér yǐ

而已.zh: 我只是不知道应该说什么而已……
而已.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ shì bù zhī dào yīng gāi shuō shén me ér yǐ
而已.en: I just don't know what to say.

而已.zh: 这只不过全是个大误会而已。
而已.pinyin: Zhè zhī bù guò quán shì gè dà wù huì ér yǐ
而已.en: It's all just a big misunderstanding.
而已.es: Todo es tan sólo un gran malentendido.

而已.pinyin: Zhǐ shì yī chǎng mèng ér yǐ

冒犯.pinyin: Tā de xíng wéi mào fàn le wǒ
冒犯.en: I was offended by his behavior.

冒犯.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎng mào fàn tā de
冒犯.en: I didn't mean to insult her.

冒犯.zh: 你的行为已经冒犯了他的尊严。
冒犯.pinyin: Nǐ de xíng wéi yǐ jīng mào fàn le tā de zūn yán
冒犯.en: Your action has offended his dignity.
冒犯.es: Tu acto ha ofendido su dignidad.

确信.zh: 我确信我们会找到解决办法的。
确信.pinyin: Wǒ què xìn wǒ men huì zhǎo dào jiě jué bàn fǎ de
确信.en: I am certain that we will find a solution.
确信.es: Estoy segura de que encontraremos una solución.

确信.pinyin: Duì yú nà ge wǒ bù què xìn
确信.en: I am not certain about that.
确信.es: No estoy seguro acerca de eso.

确信.pinyin: Wǒ hěn què xìn tā hěn cōng ming
确信.en: I'm sure that he is clever.
确信.es: Estoy seguro de que él es inteligente.

确信.zh: 您确信您不想让我和汤姆谈谈这事儿吗？
确信.pinyin: Nín què xìn nín bù xiǎng ràng wǒ hé tāng mǔ tán tán zhè shìr ma
确信.en: Are you sure you don't want me to talk to Tom about that?
确信.es: ¿Estás seguro de que no quieres que hable de eso con Tom?

往常.zh: 我和往常一样起得很早。
往常.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǎng cháng yī yàng qǐ de hěn zǎo
往常.en: I got up early as usual.

往常.zh: 她迟到了，就像往常一样。
往常.pinyin: Tā chí dào le jiù xiàng wǎng cháng yī yàng

往常.zh: 他像往常一样五点钟起床。
往常.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǎng cháng yī yàng wǔ diǎn zhōng qǐ chuáng
往常.en: He got up at five as usual.
往常.es: Él se levantó a las cinco como siempre.

往常.zh: 在冬天，太阳下山比往常更早。
往常.pinyin: Zài dōng tiān tài yang xià shān bǐ wǎng cháng gèng zǎo
往常.en: The sun sets earlier in the winter.
往常.es: El sol se oculta más temprano en invierno.

典礼.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā diǎn lǐ
典礼.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
典礼.es: No quiero participar en la ceremonia.

典礼.zh: 我理所当然地认为她会参加我们的结婚典礼。
典礼.pinyin: Wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán de rèn wéi tā huì cān jiā wǒ men de jié hūn diǎn lǐ
典礼.en: I took it for granted that she would come to our wedding.
典礼.es: Di por sentado que ella acudiría a nuestra boda.

典礼.pinyin: Zhè ge diǎn lǐ yǒu duō zhèng shì
Míng tiān jǔ xíng diǎn lǐ
典礼.en: The ceremony will take place tomorrow.

竞选.zh: 佐藤先生问了我很多有关竞选的问题。
竞选.pinyin: Zuǒ téng xiān sheng wèn le wǒ hěn duō yǒu guān jìng xuǎn de wèn tí
竞选.en: Mr. Sato asked me many questions about the election.
竞选.es: El señor Sato me hizo muchas preguntas sobre las elecciones.

竞选.pinyin: Nǐ yīng gāi jìng xuǎn shì zhǎng
Tā jiāng jìng xuǎn shì zhǎng
竞选.en: He is going to run for mayor.
竞选.es: Él se va a postular para alcalde.

竞选.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài jìng xuǎn guó huì yì yuán

作弊.zh: 他在考试中作弊时被抓到了。
作弊.pinyin: Tā zài kǎo shì zhōng zuò bì shí bèi zhuā dào le
作弊.en: He was caught cheating in the exam.
作弊.es: Le pillaron haciendo trampas en el examen.

作弊.zh: 他在生物学考试时作弊。
作弊.pinyin: Tā zài shēng wù xué kǎo shì shí zuò bì
作弊.en: He cheated on the biology exam.
作弊.es: Él copió en el examen de biología.

作弊.zh: 在考试的时候，汤姆作弊抄了玛丽的答案。
作弊.pinyin: Zài kǎo shì de shí hou tāng mǔ zuò bì chāo le mǎ lì de dá àn
作弊.en: During the exam, Tom cheated off Mary.

储蓄.zh: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。
储蓄.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài bù hǎo hǎo chǔ xù jīn qián de huà zhōng yǒu yī tiān huì hòu huǐ de
储蓄.en: Some day you will come to realize the importance of saving.
储蓄.es: Algún día te vas a dar cuenta de la importancia de ahorrar.

储蓄.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kāi gè chǔ xù zhàng hù
储蓄.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
储蓄.es: Me gustaría abrir una cuenta de ahorros.

储蓄.zh: 如果你想安享晚年，现在就要开始储蓄了。
储蓄.pinyin: Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng ān xiǎng wǎn nián xiàn zài jiù yào kāi shǐ chǔ xù le
储蓄.en: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.
储蓄.es: Si quieres seguridad en tu vejez, empieza a ahorrar ya.

幼稚.zh: 是你该放弃你幼稚手段的时候了。
幼稚.pinyin: Shì nǐ gāi fàng qì nǐ yòu zhì shǒu duàn de shí hou le
幼稚.en: It is time you left off your childish ways.
幼稚.es: Es hora de que dejes tus costumbres infantiles.

幼稚.pinyin: Tā de sī wéi fāng shì hěn yòu zhì
幼稚.en: His way of thinking is very childish.
幼稚.es: Su forma de pensar es muy infantil.

幼稚.pinyin: Bù yào nà me yòu zhì

幼稚.zh: 打消这种幼稚的念头吧。
幼稚.pinyin: Dǎ xiāo zhè zhǒng yòu zhì de niàn tou ba
幼稚.en: Get rid of those kinds of naive ideas.
幼稚.es: Deshácete de ese tipo de ideas ingenuas.

赞助.zh: 我觉得这个赞助不太合适。
赞助.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè ge zàn zhù bù tài hé shì
赞助.en: I don't think this sponsor is very suitable.

武装.pinyin: Tā men yòng qiāng wǔ zhuāng zì jǐ
Tā wǔ zhuāng dào yá chǐ
武装.en: He is armed to the teeth.

唠叨.pinyin: Wǒ bìng bù xiǎng láo dao nǐ
唠叨.en: I don't mean to nag you.

唠叨.pinyin: Bié láo dao wǒ xū yào xué xí
唠叨.en: Don't chatter! I have to study.

潮流.zh: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。
潮流.pinyin: Gēn shàng zuì jìn cháo liú shí shàng shì jiàn fēi cháng huā qián de shìr
潮流.en: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.
潮流.es: Es muy caro mantenerse al tanto con la moda actual.

潮流.pinyin: Tā shì cháo liú de nú lì
潮流.en: She is a slave of fashion.

潮流.zh: 今年的时尚潮流完全不同于去年。
潮流.pinyin: Jīn nián de shí shàng cháo liú wán quán bù tóng yú qù nián
潮流.en: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.

焦急.zh: 我焦急地在等着去聚会。
焦急.pinyin: Wǒ jiāo jí de zài děng zhe qù jù huì
焦急.en: I'm looking forward to the party.

焦急.zh: 我为你的殿，心里焦急，如同火烧。
焦急.pinyin: Wǒ wèi nǐ de diàn xīn li jiāo jí rú tóng huǒ shāo
焦急.en: Zeal for your house will consume me.

焦急.zh: 就算你多焦急，也不能帮上甚么忙。
焦急.pinyin: Jiù suàn nǐ duō jiāo jí yě bù néng bāng shàng shèn má máng
焦急.en: No matter how much you hurry your effort is just a drop in the bucket.

素质.zh: 这条路上的许多居民素质都很差。
素质.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shang de xǔ duō jū mín sù zhì dōu hěn chà
素质.en: Most of the residents on this street are wrong 'uns.
素质.es: Muchos residentes de esta calle tienen bajo nivel de educación.

素质.zh: 在限定时间内完成任务是一个职员的基本素质。
素质.pinyin: Zài xiàn dìng shí jiān nèi wán chéng rèn wu shì yī ge zhí yuán de jī běn sù zhì
素质.en: It is a basic quality of an employee to complete his tasks within a fixed time.

衰退.zh: 我们不能愁闷地看着这个城市就这样衰退下去。
衰退.pinyin: Wǒ men bù néng chóu mèn de kàn zhe zhè ge chéng shì jiù zhè yàng shuāi tuì xià qù
衰退.en: We can't just look on dejectedly while this city continues to go into decline.

论坛.zh: 我在这些论坛上没有帐号。
论坛.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè xiē lùn tán shàng méi yǒu zhàng hào
论坛.en: I do not have an account in these forums.
论坛.es: Yo no tengo una cuenta en estos foros.

掰.zh: 面条下锅前要先掰成小块。
掰.pinyin: Miàn tiáo xià guō qián yào xiān bāi chéng xiǎo kuài
掰.en: Before you put the noodles in the pot, you have to break them up into small pieces.

注射.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ zhù shè zhǐ tòng yào
注射.en: I'll give you a painkilling injection.

注射.zh: 你最后一次注射胰岛素之后有正常饮食吗？
注射.pinyin: Nǐ zuì hòu yī cì zhù shè yí dǎo sù zhī hòu yǒu zhèng cháng yǐn shí ma
注射.en: Have you been keeping up a normal diet since the last shot of insulin?

演绎.zh: 这段旋律的演绎真是完美无瑕。
演绎.pinyin: Zhè duàn xuán lǜ de yǎn yì zhēn shi wán měi wú xiá
演绎.es: La ejecución de la melodía fue magistral.

传授.zh: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。
传授.pinyin: Huā dài jià suǒ huàn lái de yī diǎn cái zhì dǐ guo bié ren chuán shòu de shǔ bèi bù zhǐ
传授.en: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.

悬挂.pinyin: Tā de huà bèi xuán guà zài qiáng shàng
悬挂.en: His pictures were hung on the wall.

遮挡.zh: 应该为这些花遮挡风雨。
遮挡.pinyin: Yīng gāi wèi zhè xiē huā zhē dǎng fēng yǔ
遮挡.en: These flowers should be sheltered from the rain.
遮挡.es: Esas flores deben protegerse de la lluvia.

阐述.zh: 他简单地阐述了他的理由。
阐述.pinyin: Tā jiǎn dān de chǎn shù le tā de lǐ yóu
阐述.en: He gave his reasons in brief.
阐述.es: Él dio sus razones de forma resumida.

汤姆.zh: 汤姆说他打扫屋子打扫了一天。
汤姆.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shuō tā dǎ sǎo wū zi dǎ sǎo le yī tiān
汤姆.en: Tom said that he had been cleaning the house all day.
汤姆.es: Tom dijo que había estado limpiando la casa el día entero.

汤姆.pinyin: Tāng mǔ yòu táo kè le
汤姆.es: Tom faltó a clases otra vez.

汤姆.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hái bù huì yóu yǒng

汤姆.zh: 汤姆还在依赖他父母吗?
汤姆.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hái zài yī lài tā fù mǔ ma
汤姆.en: Does Tom still rely on his parents?

出去.zh: 我出去的时候有人打我电话吗？
出去.pinyin: Wǒ chū qù de shí hou yǒu rén dá wǒ diàn huà ma
出去.en: Did anyone call me while I was out?
出去.es: ¿Me ha llamado alguien mientras estaba fuera?

出去.pinyin: Yǔ bù tíng wǒ men bù huì chū qù
出去.en: We won't go out if it doesn't stop raining.
出去.es: Si no para de llover, no podemos ir.

出去.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài chū qù le

出去.zh: 穿上你的鞋，我们出去吃晚饭。
出去.pinyin: Chuān shang nǐ de xié wǒ men chū qù chī wǎn fàn
出去.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
出去.es: Ponte los zapatos y vamos a cenar.

不是吗.pinyin: Nǐ lèi le bù shì ma

不是吗.zh: 我们很快就到这儿了，不是吗？
不是吗.pinyin: Wǒ men hěn kuài jiù dào zhèr le bù shì ma
不是吗.en: We arrived here fast, didn't we?

不是吗.pinyin: Tā zhēn de hěn cōng ming bù shì ma
Nà shi zhuàng gāo lóu bù shì ma
不是吗.en: That is a high building, is it not?

派对.pinyin: Nǐ lái bù lái wǒ de pài duì a
派对.en: Would you like to come to my party?
派对.es: ¿Por qué no vienes a mi fiesta?

派对.zh: 她邀请我们去她的生日派对。
派对.pinyin: Tā yāo qǐng wǒ men qù tā de shēng rì pài duì
派对.en: She invited us to her birthday party.
派对.es: Ella nos invitó a su fiesta de cumpleaños.

派对.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ cān jiā pài duì
派对.en: I'd like to invite you to the party.

派对.zh: 我很高兴你能来参加派对。
派对.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāo xìng nǐ néng lái cān jiā pài duì
派对.en: I'm glad you could come to the party.
派对.es: Me alegra que hayas podido venir a la fiesta.

带来.zh: 科技的进步为我们的生活带来了巨大的转变。
带来.pinyin: Kē jì de jìn bù wèi wǒ men de shēng huó dài lái le jù dà de zhuǎn biàn
带来.en: The progress of science has brought about great change in our lives.
带来.es: Los progresos de la ciencia han aportado grandes cambios a nuestras vidas.

带来.zh: 电视的发明为我们的生活模式带来了巨大的变化。
带来.pinyin: Diàn shì de fā míng wèi wǒ men de shēng huó mó shì dài lái le jù dà de biàn huà
带来.en: The invention of TV caused a drastic change in our daily life.
带来.es: La invención de la televisión provocó un cambio drástico en nuestra vida cotidiana.

带来.zh: 一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。
带来.pinyin: Yī shí shī yán cháng cháng huì dài lái yì xiǎng bù dào de jié guǒ
带来.en: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
带来.es: Un lapsus a menudo ocasiona resultados inesperados.

带来.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng gěi nǐ dài lái má fan
带来.en: I don't want to get you into trouble.

记.zh: 我完全记不起你的名字了。
记.pinyin: Wǒ wán quán jì bù qǐ nǐ de míng zi le
记.es: No me acuerdo de tu nombre en absoluto.

记.zh: 你记不记得我们认识的那一天？
记.pinyin: Nǐ jì bù jì de wǒ men rèn shi de nà yī tiān
记.en: Do you remember the day when we first met?
记.es: ¿Te acuerdas del día en que nos conocimos?

记.zh: 她总是把老师说的话一字不差地记下来。
记.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì bǎ lǎo shī shuō de huà yī zì bù chà de jì xià lai
记.en: She always writes down every word her teacher says.
记.es: Ella siempre anota cada palabra que dice el profesor.

冰.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
冰.pinyin: Hú shàng de bīng tài báo le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
冰.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
冰.es: El hielo sobre el lago es demasiado fino como para soportar tu peso.

冰.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào bīng jī lín zuò tián diǎn
冰.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

冰.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。
冰.pinyin: Bīng hòu de zú yǐ ràng wǒ zài shàng miàn zǒu lù
冰.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
冰.es: El hielo era lo suficientemente grueso para que yo pudiera andar sobre él.

冰.zh: 你不该吃太多冰激淋和太多意大利面。
冰.pinyin: Nǐ bù gāi chī tài duō bīng jī lín hé tài duō yì dà lì miàn
冰.en: You mustn't eat too much ice cream and spaghetti.
冰.es: No debes comer demasiado helado y espagueti.

声.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào le qiāo mén shēng
声.en: I heard a knock at the door.
声.es: Oí un golpe en la puerta.

声.pinyin: Nǐ zhì shǎo gāi shuō shēng xiè xie ba
声.en: You might at least say "thank you."

声.pinyin: Tā shuō le shēng zài jiàn jiù zǒu le

声.zh: 我听到轻柔的沙沙声从远方的路上传来。
声.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào qīng róu de shā shā shēng cóng yuǎn fāng de lù shang chuán lái
声.en: In the distance I hear the sound of softly murmuring roads.

最高.zh: 这是我见过的最高的男人了。
最高.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ jiàn guo de zuì gāo de nán rén le
最高.en: This is the tallest man I've ever seen.
最高.es: Es el hombre más alto que he visto en mi vida.

最高.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì tā jiā lǐ zuì gāo de
最高.en: Tom is the tallest in his family.
最高.es: Tom es el más alto de su familia.

最高.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì bān shàng zuì gāo de
最高.en: Tom is the tallest in his class.
最高.es: Tom es el más alto de su clase.

最高.pinyin: Zhè shì rì běn zuì gāo de tǎ
最高.en: This is the tallest tower in Japan.
最高.es: Ésta es la torre más alta de Japón.

怎么了.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ wǒ de bǐ zěn me le
怎么了.en: What have you done with my pen?

怎么了.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ wǒ de xíng li zěn me le
怎么了.en: What did you do with my baggage?

怎么了.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ wǒ de yǎn jìng zěn me le
怎么了.en: What did you do with my glasses?

怎么了.pinyin: Nǐ de gǒu zěn me le

外语.pinyin: Jiǎng wài yǔ shì bù róng yì de
外语.en: Speaking foreign languages is not easy.
外语.es: Hablar idiomas extranjeros no es fácil.

外语.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐ huan xué wài yǔ
外语.en: I like to study foreign languages.

外语.pinyin: Wǒ xué liǎng zhǒng wài yǔ
外语.en: I am learning two foreign languages.

外语.pinyin: Xué xí wài yǔ shì kùn nan de
外语.en: Learning a foreign language is difficult.
外语.es: Aprender una lengua extranjera es difícil.
